featured_reviews.name: radhai Meenakshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Review for Silbatta Purchase from Ghori Décor

I had been searching for a silbatta for a long time, but it wasn’t available anywhere around my localities in Chennai. While searching online, I came across Ghori Décor on IndiaMART, and got in touch with Mr. Nadeem Ghori from Mumbai. I had a few customizations in mind, and he patiently listened and informed me that the product was in Rajasthan, and he would be able to check when he traveled there the next month.

Honestly, I lost hope, thinking I might never hear back. But to my surprise, Mr. Nadeem remembered me and followed up in mid-March, sending me exactly the piece I had been looking for since February. I was truly amazed at his sincerity and commitment. Due to personal health reasons, I couldn’t respond promptly, yet he reminded me again with so much patience and care.

Finally, in August, he managed to send me the silbatta through parcel service. One piece arrived in perfect condition, while another was slightly damaged. When I informed him, he immediately took full responsibility and didn’t even charge me for the damaged piece — something that is truly rare to see in today’s world. He only took the payment for the perfect piece and the courier charges.

This experience has been more than just a purchase — it was about trust, humanity, and genuine customer service. Every time I see my silbatta, I feel grateful for Mr. Nadeem Ghori, even though we have never met in person. In 2025, it is rare to find someone who values service and relationships above money, and I feel blessed to have come across such a person.

Highly recommend Ghori Décor for their honesty, quality, and heartfelt service. 🙏
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much for sharing such a heartfelt and detailed experience 🙏

Your words truly mean a lot to us. It was our pleasure to assist you in finding the perfect silbatta, and we’re glad it finally reached you. Your patience, trust, and understanding throughout the journey are deeply appreciated.

At Ghori Décor, we always believe in building relationships beyond just business, and your feedback reassures us that we are on the right path.

Wishing you good health and happiness always. Looking forward to serving you again! 😊
